pages.title: Abyssal Silicate
pages.text: Titan's rocky core, under its hidden ocean: hydrated silicate, soaked through for four billion years. Found on the floor of Titan's hidden ocean. Hot water through it gives hydrogen (serpentinisation); eight cobblestone and a Vent Biofilm make more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hydrogen, Hydrothermal Chimney.
